summary: Every operation and every golden shut height, stroke and dimension is present on the right press, with correct doc number, revision and dates. It fails on the header Stage No. ('PP-010 to PP-110'), and on 14 actionable additions not in the golden, all from the PPAP: F-PRD-17, min/max shut heights, hourly and per-lot sampling, a 28 mm piercing dimension, R3 on Forming I, LH/RH bins, RPO and the UNIT-III transfer. Rework rejects rusted material instead of cleaning it, the packing row fixes the logistic sheet instead of repacking, and the part list merges LH and RH into one row with no quantity.
